text: You used to be as famous as me, but you got replaced.
You saw something that could have ruined me, and you haven’t told anyone.
When I was a Harpy, I was obsessed with you.
After my surgeries, you told me about when I was once human.
You’ve snuck into my bunks and gotten high with me.
You held me down while they injected me with sedatives and shoved me in the cockpit. Maybe you even held the needle yourself.
You have a Personal Bond with your Mentor.
We had a mutual friend who the Foundation chose not to save.
Even now, nobody thinks you have a chance of being a better pilot than me.
I met you when you were too young to pilot, and froze when I saw you again in the briefing room.
You were the newest member of my last Cadre, which we were the only survivors of.
I watch you every day, and you haven’t noticed me yet.
You’ve talked to me once.
We’ve tried to murder each other.
You’ve crawled into my bunk in the middle of the night.
The mechanics taught you how to tune up my body.
I flagged you for recruitment when you were a civilian.
You took hold of me when I was broken, and have never let me go.
We’re sisters, and I’ve promised to protect you.

text.void_and_unmark_all: I embrace her, flesh trading for flesh, gaining Void and unmarking all Identities
text.erase_identity_and_table_question: I allow her to grow up my brainstem, erasing an Identity in exchange for strange insight; I ask any question, and the table answers.
text.nearby_npcs_gain_void: I spew un-real radiation, causing nearby NPCs to gain Void.
text.table_replaces_identity: I submit to her wholly. The table will decide what new Identity she grants me, and which it replaces
text.locked_cockpit_extraction_requires_frame: I am subsumed by her, molding with her flesh. The cockpit is locked, all vitals are dead. I cannot be extracted without her consent.

text: Report on your cadremates behaviour and activities.
Always refer to Girls by their official pronouns (it/its)
Always be kind, helpful, and obedient towards civilians and base staff, unless it would contradict your other orders.
Take care of your Handler’s day-to-day — cleaning their weapons, making their bed, pouring their tea.
Never show weakness or hesitancy in front of an underling.
Present yourself as finely-groomed and impeccably dressed at all times.
Never act in a way that would stain your family’s name.
Encourage any young girls you meet to take the aptitude test to become a pilot.
Never have a romantic relationship with any of your cadremates (your Handler may designate you an appropriate alternative partner).
It’s the duty of the strong to make use of the weak.
No matter where the meat comes from, say thank you for the meal.
Nothing feels better than piloting.
The cogs of the Foundation will grind everyone to dust — no exceptions.
Keeping yourself alive is the only thing that matters.
There’s nothing waiting for us if we retire.
A good grudge is the best fuel.
Never piss off your engineer.
A pretty face looks best when bloody.
There’s no point getting attached to a doomed dog.
